verdict.rationale: PostHog's data warehouse syncs external sources such as Postgres and "dozens of other sources" and lets you query them alongside events in one SQL query. Batch exports schedule data exports to supported destinations, which the query docs name as the supported mechanism for bulk or recurring exports. Realtime CDP destinations, including a generic webhook, also stream events out as they arrive. missing for 10: named warehouse destinations for batch exports (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery/S3), named warehouse sources beyond Postgres, details on export cadence and continuity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
